left.label: Context panel
media.title: Media
media.dragHint: Drag to the timeline · double-click to preview
media.noneHint: Import from your PotionUI library or gallery, from this computer, or drop files here.
media.useAsFrame: Use as frame at the playhead
media.deleteTip: Remove from the project; the file stays in your library
story.title: Storyboard
story.placeholder: Tell the film in a few sentences: each sentence becomes a shot.
story.proposeTip: Sentence split; ask the assistant for a real breakdown
story.sequenceHint: Final film makes each shot final from its Final take; “Sequence” with Final in the Production bar renders everything again.
story.allDone: Every shot is final or comes from a source.
story.noShots: No shots yet: write the synopsis and propose a breakdown, or add a shot in the Storyboard.
story.continuityOk: Color and identity matches are consistent.
story.continuityNone: No match to check yet: the shots have no image.
queue.title: Generation queue
queue.slotsTip: Takes handed to the engine, out of how many of your takes may run at once.
queue.elsewhere.one: {count} more take of yours is in the queue for another project: all your projects share one queue.
queue.elsewhere.other: {count} more takes of yours are in the queue for other projects: all your projects share one queue.
queue.emptyHint: The takes waiting for the engine or running on it show here, in the order they run.
queue.prioritize: Move take {variant} to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeTip: Move to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeNo: Already first, or already handed to the engine
dock.bible.label: Visual tag
dock.bible.labelHint.characters: the red-haired woman in the navy raincoat
dock.bible.noLabel: Without a visual tag, the card enters no prompt. Write it the same way in the instructions of the shots.
dock.bible.textHint.characters: One fixed paragraph: face, hair, build, costume.
dock.bible.textHint.places: One fixed paragraph: place, light, materials.
dock.bible.propsHint: a brass lantern, a red scarf
dock.bible.referencesHint.characters: Optional. With MiniMax H3 in Ref2VA, a linked Identity reference sent with a shot is defined with the words of this card.
dock.bible.referencesHint.places: Optional. With MiniMax H3 in Ref2VA, a linked Sets reference sent with a shot is defined with the words of this card.
dock.bible.noReferences.characters: The project has no Identity reference.
dock.bible.noReferences.places: The project has no Sets reference.
dock.bible.removed: Card deleted, and taken out of the shots that cast it.
dock.bible.convert: The Characters and identity field is free text added to the prompt of every shot. You can keep it, or turn it into a character card cast in every shot.
dock.bible.converted.one: Card created and cast in {count} shot: check its visual tag.
dock.bible.converted.other: Card created and cast in {count} shots: check its visual tag.
director.check.title: To check
director.check.cited: {shot}: the card {name} is named but not cast
director.check.unnamed: {shot}: the card {name} is cast but not named in the instruction
director.review.noShotsHint: Split the synopsis into shots in the Storyboard, then generate them with the Production bar.
director.review.noTakes: No take: {key} generates the chosen shot.
director.review.finals.one: {count} shot with a final out of {total}
director.review.finals.other: {count} shots with a final out of {total}
director.direction.subtitle: {chars} / {max} chars · added to the prompt of every shot
director.direction.castText: Characters and places are cards of the Bible, cast shot by shot. This field stays a free text added to the prompt of every shot.
director.bible.emptyHint: One card per character or place: its text goes word for word into the shots that cast it, its images to the engines that take them.
director.aside.hint: The prompt this shot would send to the engine of the project with the current direction. It follows what you type.
director.aside.none: Create shots in the Storyboard to see the composed prompt.
director.aside.noCard: Choose a card of the Bible to edit it here.
mixer.noSoundsHint: Import music, voices or ambiences; the Sound design workshop prepares some too.
